name: Noiphelyn
source:
Noiphelyn overslept and wakes up from a bad dream, only to realize everyone except her friend left home. What happens when you are awake to a new nightmare subverting reality? 

Rumour has it that things happen during the night, and they are about to find out with their lives at stake.

Will Noiphelyn stay in one piece, safe and sound?

[Taken from [URL=https://namelessdistrict.itch.io/noiphelyn]Itch.io[/URL]]
